description: Projective texture placement, excluded UV windows, and mirrored-repeat displacement contracts.

mutants.description: Accept a point behind the projective camera by testing the magnitude of homogeneous w instead of its sign; the public projection guard must reject it.
Apply the ordinary scale/rotation/offset transform to a projective UV even though the projector matrix already produces normalized coordinates.
Drop mirrored-repeat reflection so the second texture tile samples the ordinary wrapped image instead of the reflected image.
